description: The Escaliers du Marché are the covered wooden stairs that climb from the foot of Rue Mercerie toward the cathedral parvis in Lausanne, beside a steep paved lane and a row of tall houses. The present flights date from 1717 to 1719, and Rue Pierre-Viret crosses the upper part. This is the stair, not the cathedral front and not Ouchy. The Open-Meteo model is overcast and mild, about 19°C, with a breeze and no precipitation, and the sun is below the horizon.
